labels.rationale: SDC binds d_i to src_clk. dst_q directly samples it in a declared-asynchronous domain with no containment chain.

Top-level input d_i is constrained to launch on src_clk (intent.sdc:5), which is declared asynchronous to dst_clk (intent.sdc:4), yet dst_q captures d_i directly on posedge dst_clk (design.sv:13) in a single stage without a synchronizer or qualifier (CDC-029 ERROR Established).
